There are two shorter (2.07 Å) and two longer (2.08 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Both Mg-F bond lengths are 2.05 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three MgO₄F₂ octahedra.
